name: impact-record
title: Impact and provenance record profile
description: Optional CMS profile for linking an economic action to activity and evidence in the package. Not part of the scientific core. Status is allocation state, not a verified conservation outcome.
rules: Campaign association alone MUST NOT be exported as spend on a survey. Only explicit allocations belong in impactRecords.
evidenceObservationIDs MUST reference observations that exist in this package.
Do not label activity counts as outcomes.
